effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] While a Digimon card with [MetalGreymon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When this Digimon has [Omnimon] or [Greymon] in its name (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon] or [DexDoruGreymon]), it gets +2000 DP.
